items.title: 沙迦SEWA公布逾52亿迪拉姆能源与水务战略项目
items.title_en: Sharjah SEWA unveils over AED5.2 billion in strategic energy and water projects
items.summary: 沙迦电力水务及燃气局公布总值超过52亿迪拉姆的能源与水务战略项目，重点支持供水安全及公用设施发展。金额为项目组合规模，并非新授予的单一建设合同。
items.summary_en: Sharjah Electricity, Water and Gas Authority announced strategic energy and water projects valued at more than AED5.2 billion to support water security and utility infrastructure. This is an investment portfolio, not a single newly awarded construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 涉及多种基础设施需求，但具体采购与已报道的变电站项目须分别核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: The portfolio indicates varied infrastructure demand; individual tenders and earlier-reported substations must be distinguished.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注输配水、机电设备、网络工程及后续工程采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor water networks, electromechanical equipment, grid works and subsequent procurement.

items.title: DEWA International与上海电气签署全球能源水务项目合作备忘录
items.title_en: DEWA International and Shanghai Electric sign MoU for global energy and water projects
items.sector: 中国企业出海与公用事业
items.summary: DEWA International与上海电气签署合作备忘录，探索在全球市场联合识别、开发、投资及参与电力、水务和基础设施项目，涉及光伏、储能、海水淡化、输配电及绿氢等。尚未宣布具体项目合同。
items.summary_en: DEWA International and Shanghai Electric signed an MoU to identify, develop, invest in and bid for international energy, water and infrastructure projects, including solar power, storage, desalination, transmission and green hydrogen. No specific project award was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 为跨国能源基础设施合作建立框架，未构成已授工程合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: It establishes a framework for cross-border energy development, not an awarded project.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进中国企业海外项目开发、设备供应及商务服务合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track outbound Chinese engineering, equipment supply and commercial partnership opportunities.

items.title: 迪拜正式公布Nad Zabeel未来研发创新园区
items.title_en: Dubai announces Nad Zabeel Future RDI Campus
items.summary: 迪拜于11月1日公布Nad Zabeel未来研究、开发与创新园区，计划汇聚科研机构、实验室、技术企业与国际合作项目。公告未确认施工合同或投资金额。
items.summary_en: Dubai announced the Nad Zabeel Future Research, Development and Innovation Campus on 1 November, envisaging research institutions, laboratories, technology companies and global collaboration. No construction contract value was confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 属于未来科研园区建设线索，而非已公开授标工程。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is an early-stage research-campus development lead rather than an awarded construction contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注科研设施设计、建设及园区运营服务需求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor laboratory facilities, campus construction and related services.

items.title: 巴林四个重大投资项目获黄金许可证，总值38.9亿美元
items.title_en: Bahrain grants Golden Licences to four investment projects totalling USD3.89 billion
items.summary: 巴林在Gateway Gulf 2026向四个重大项目授予黄金许可证，合计计划投资38.9亿美元，涉及航空维修物流、滨海酒店住宅及ICT创新。获得许可证并不代表全部项目已开工。
items.summary_en: Bahrain granted Golden Licences to four major projects at Gateway Gulf 2026 with planned investment totalling USD3.89 billion across aviation logistics and maintenance, waterfront hospitality and residences, and technology. Licensing does not mean construction has begun on every project.
items.why_it_matters: 有多行业潜在建设与供应链机会，但投资与采购阶段不同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The projects may offer construction and supply-chain leads, although licensing and procurement are different stages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注航空设施、酒店物业及ICT园区配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track aviation facilities, hotels, residences and ICT infrastructure supply.

items.title: 非洲金融公司与绿色气候基金推出6.9亿美元主权气候融资机制
items.title_en: Africa Finance Corporation and Green Climate Fund launch USD690 million sovereign climate facility
items.summary: 非洲金融公司与绿色气候基金于10月30日宣布6.9亿美元非洲主权气候融资机制，首期重点覆盖安哥拉、贝宁、科特迪瓦与尼日利亚，促进适应气候变化及低碳基础设施投资。该金额不是单项EPC合同。
items.summary_en: Africa Finance Corporation and the Green Climate Fund launched the USD690 million Africa Sovereign Climate Facility on 30 October, initially focused on Angola, Benin, Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria to support climate-resilient and low-carbon investments. This is a financing programme, not an EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 融资机制有利于未来项目孵化，具体建设清单尚需进一步披露。
items.why_it_matters_en: The facility may unlock later projects, but individual construction pipelines require further identification.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟踪水务、能源与气候韧性工程融资项目。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor financed water, energy and climate-resilient infrastructure opportunities.

items.title: 非洲能源银行正式成立，授权资本50亿美元
items.title_en: Africa Energy Bank formally established with USD5 billion authorised capital
items.summary: 非洲进出口银行与非洲产油国组织宣布非洲能源银行正式成立，授权资本50亿美元，目标支持油气勘探、生产、运输、加工及炼化等能源产业投资。授权资本并非已发放融资。
items.summary_en: Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation announced the formal establishment of Africa Energy Bank with USD5 billion in authorised capital, intended to finance energy exploration, production, transport, processing and refining. Authorised capital is not disbursed lending.
items.why_it_matters: 有助于形成未来能源项目融资渠道，但暂非采购招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: It provides a prospective financing channel for energy projects, not a current procurement tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注港口油气物流、加工设施及能源施工项目。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track oil and gas logistics, processing facilities and energy construction opportunities.

items.title: 阿曼穆桑代姆14项发展与服务提案获批推进
items.title_en: Oman's Musandam advances 14 approved development and service proposals
items.sector: 区域基础设施与城市发展
items.summary: 穆桑代姆市政委员会公布14项获批发展与公共服务提案，涉及Madha光伏用地、食品安全设施及Lima城市更新。Khasab综合旅游港仍处研究阶段，未宣布建设合同。
items.summary_en: Musandam's municipal council reported 14 approved development and service initiatives including a solar site in Madha, food-security facilities and urban renewal in Lima. The proposed integrated tourist port in Khasab remains under study, with no construction contract announced.
items.why_it_matters: 部分项目进入推进阶段，但具体工程包及采购时间未明确。
items.why_it_matters_en: Some initiatives are moving forward, while detailed work packages and procurement timing are not yet specified.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注光伏、社区更新、公共设施与供应链配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor solar facilities, urban upgrades and associated public-infrastructure supply.

items.title: 阿曼苏哈尔Atlas Steel规划逾1.12亿里亚尔钢铁综合工厂
items.title_en: Oman's Atlas Steel plans integrated steelmaking and rebar facility exceeding RO112 million
items.category: 既有投资协议细节更新
items.summary: Atlas Steel计划在苏哈尔工业城投资超过1.12亿阿曼里亚尔，建设年产72万吨钢坯的电弧炉炼钢设施和70万吨钢筋轧制产线。该项目属于10月28日已报道的一批投资协议的细节披露，并非新增独立投资额。
items.summary_en: Atlas Steel plans to invest more than RO112 million in an integrated steelmaking and rebar complex at Suhar Industrial City, with 720,000 tonnes of annual steelmaking capacity and a 700,000-tonne rebar mill. This elaborates an investment already included in the 28 October agreements, not an additional independent investment.
items.why_it_matters: 项目设备与厂房建设具有潜在采购需求，但应避免将原投资重复计量。
items.why_it_matters_en: The facility may generate plant and equipment procurement, while its investment must not be double counted.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注电弧炉、工业厂房、动力系统及工程分包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor electric-arc-furnace equipment, industrial buildings, power systems and subcontracting.
